title: Kestrel Handover Terms Table — Signing Lead Time, Odometer Tolerance and Insurance Proof
content:
Vehicle Purchase Agreements carry four handover terms that vary, or could vary, by vehicle program.

| Vehicle program | Minimum calendar days between signing and handover | Odometer tolerance at handover (miles above the listing odometer) | Verified proof of insurance naming the VIN required before handover | Highest comprehensive and collision deductible accepted on a financed order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 1 | 250 | Yes | $1000.00 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 1 | 250 | Yes | $1000.00 |
| Kestrel Certified | 1 | 200 | Yes | $1000.00 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 1 | 200 | Yes | $1000.00 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 1 | 150 | Yes | $1000.00 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 1 | 150 | Yes | $1000.00 |

**Reading the table.**
- A signing lead of 1 calendar day means the handover date falls at least one calendar day after the signing date; a same-day handover is not within this figure.
- The odometer tolerance is the number of miles the handover odometer may exceed the odometer disclosed on the listing before the buyer may decline the vehicle at handover.
- The deductible figure applies to orders paid through Kestrel Auto Finance or an outside lender.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Certified vehicle listed at 31200 miles shows 31450 miles on the handover checklist: the variance is 250 miles, which is more than that program's 200-mile tolerance. The same variance on a Kestrel Value Line vehicle equals its 250-mile tolerance and is not more than it.
